verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ML-generated risk scores (fraud risk, merchant dispute risk, card testing) surfaced on every authorization, real-time synchronous authorization webhooks to approve/decline, spending controls to block by merchant/country/MID, and replacement-card flows for lost/stolen/compromised cards plus a disputes workflow. This covers scoring at auth time, blocking, and reissuance as described in the story. Missing for 10: no evidence of a dedicated proactive 'suspicious activity alert' notification feed (beyond auth webhooks) and no independent/hands-on validation of fraud-model accuracy or alerting UX.
